name: PUMA Philippine Half Marathon Series — Manila Leg
short_description: A half-marathon event organized by RUNRIO Inc. on October 11, 2026 at SM Mall of Asia Complex, Pasay City, Philippines.
ai_summary: The PUMA Philippine Half Marathon Series — Manila Leg is a half-marathon event scheduled for October 11, 2026, organized by RUNRIO Inc.
